adapter_summary.mechanism: parse_cupti_kernel_record is a template over the DELIVERED struct (member-name access): CUPTI 12.6 -> CUpti_ActivityKernel9; CUDA 13 -> CUpti_ActivityKernel10 via the ActivityKernelT typedef (CUPTI_API_VERSION > 24). Kernel10 == Kernel9 + isDeviceLaunched (uint8_t) + 3 pad bytes at the tail; NO field moved, NO field removed (kKernel10TailDelta asserted). isDeviceLaunched read through SFINAE member detection.
adapter_summary.layout_pin: 23 kKernelFieldMap entries static_asserted to their 12.6 offsets (kind@0 .. localMemoryTotal_v2@192, sizeof 208) so a CUPTI header bump fails loudly instead of mis-parsing (Metis L-5)
adapter_summary.cuda13_migration: Event/Metric/PC-sampling-activity APIs removed (CUPTI_ERROR_LEGACY_PROFILER_NOT_SUPPORTED=38) - tracer uses Activity API only, never nvprof/Event/Metric; nvprof removed in 13.0; Profiling/PerfWorks deprecated -> Range Profiler/PM Sampling; multi-subscriber V2 APIs (cuptiSubscribe_v2 etc.) 13.3+ - 12.x single-tool scope documented (Metis H-2); CUPTI_API_VERSION 24==12.6, 13.0==130001
adapter_summary.enable_set: CONCURRENT_KERNEL (kind 10) + RUNTIME + DRIVER + OVERHEAD (kineto); KERNEL kind 3 NEVER enabled (serializes kernels); forced flush cuptiActivityFlushAll(CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_FLUSH_FORCED) at stop; latency timestamps off by default
adapter_summary.reuse: libs/cupti-sub (todo 44) reused: every buffer record first routed through kernscope::cupti::handle_activity_record (MEMORY -> shared allocation map), kFallbackLogLine degradation contract shared

risks_deviations: Record iteration is our own iterator mirroring cuptiActivityGetNextRecord (kind->size table + 8-byte alignment) so truncation is DETECTABLE; the real CUPTI path returns CUPTI_ERROR_INVALID_KIND for incomplete records - behavior documented in record_adapter.h; rental run should cross-check alignment
DriverlessBoxDegradesGracefully skips when libcupti.so is dlopen-able (this host has the runtime lib but no NVIDIA driver; the start path is rental-validated per scripts/rental-validate.sh)
AMD grid_size reported both raw (work items, grid_size) and converted to blocks (grid); conversion documented as in todo-45 (blocks = grid/wg per dim)
AMD tracer links librocprofiler-sdk.so by path (ROCPROF_SDK_OUT) - same pattern as libs/capture-hip; requires devenv env at configure
